reason: Card up front, a 3-day window, then payments are final and there are zero published results. Three days isn't enough time to see if cold DMs even get replies, so I'd either cancel on day 3 having learned nothing or get stuck paying $147 for something unproven.
objection: Three days can't show me whether this books calls, and after day 4 it's non-refundable with no customer results to go on. That's a trap structure. The 'founding seats' counter at 7 of 100 also reads like manufactured urgency.
would_change_my_mind: A 7-day or 14-day trial with no card, or a real refund window after the first charge. Even one or two named agency owners showing actual reply and booking numbers would do it.
